Forty-five prepubertal and 42 pubertal, clinically normal black and white children participated. Dual-energy x-ray absorptiometry was used to determine body composition. A computed tomography scan of the abdomen was used to determine visceral adipose tissue and s.c. adipose tissue. Daily physical activity/inactivity was assessed by questionnaire.
